$comment: Third-party files that ship as they are, copied into the app by scripts/build.mjs rather than bundled by esbuild, so esbuild's metafile does not see them (supply chain, docs/DEPENDENCIES.md). scripts/third-party.mjs checks every file's SHA-256 (in the repository and in the build output) and fails the build on any difference or any file not listed here, and puts each entry in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt and the SBOM. Updating one: take the files from the registry tarball named in 'source' (check its sha512 against 'integrity'), then update the hashes here.
